reviews.text:
I had to write a review because thank God for this place. It's the only vet ER or even UrgentCare for that matter that actually acts with a sense of urgency the moment you walk in. They literally yell "New Patient" to make sure someone comes to attend you right away. Before arriving I called and they immediately transferred me to an actual doctor to discuss the issue and advise whether I should come in which I had never experienced before.

Once there, the staff was extremely kind, competent, and professional despite the chaos and heaviness of an ER environment. A nurse attended me immediately and the doctor came by very shortly after to check on my cat and lay out a detailed plan based on what I told her. They have many payment options and were very flexible and patient. I saw them conduct a procedure on my cat and was impressed and at ease with how everything was done. Thank God my cat was okay and I'd recommend this ER to anyone concerned for their pet's health and safety.

I truly can’t say enough good things about the team at VEG. Everyone there was absolutely amazing, kind, compassionate, and professional.
During such a stressful and emotional time with my cat, they made me feel like I wasn’t alone. They genuinely cared about both my cat and me, and you could feel that they were doing everything they could to help us.
I especially want to thank Tori, one of the nurses. She was truly an angel to me. Her kindness, patience, and compassion meant more than I can explain. She made such a difficult situation feel a little easier, and I will never forget how supportive she was.
The entire team went above and beyond for us. They treated my cat with so much care and treated me with so much understanding and kindness. You can really feel that these people care deeply about the animals and the families who come through their doors.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you to Tori and the entire VEG team for everything you did for us. I’m so incredibly grateful. 🤍🐾

VEG completely exceeded my expectations. Everyone from the woman who answered the phone to the intake triage, to the vet tech, to the veterinarian were excellent. They were really sweet & compassionate. And they let me stay with my pet the whole time.

They are amazing. The night before, I had been at a different emergency care facility where they took my dog away for treatment and I wasn’t able to be present while she was being cared for. Here, it was completely different. You are able to stay with your pet while they are being treated, which gave me so much peace of mind. They truly do everything they can to help your pet and provide the medications and care they need. I never felt like they were trying to oversell me a product or service. Instead, they provided incredible support, reassurance, and genuine care. You can tell that they truly care about your pets and are genuinely interested in helping them get better, beyond simply making a sale. All I can say is thank you. We desperately needed help the day before my dog’s surgery for a fracture, and they gave us the care, compassion, and support we needed to make sure she was comfortable and able to make it safely to her surgery the following day. I am truly grateful for everything they did for us.

"My experience was excellent."
Surgeon Natassjia Ragbeer is truly incredible—very professional.
Stela and Oriana were very attentive and dedicated, and they show that they do their work with a lot of love and professionalism,
just like the rest of the staff.

I am deeply grateful to the entire clinic team—especially the two angels, Dr. Pendranghelu and Nurse Sandra—who did the impossible to save our baby, Micha. Words cannot express my gratitude; his passing was calm and peaceful. Thank you. Please continue to bring that same love and dedication to every family that places their trust in you, just as we did.

My older Maltese has heart problems & was not behaving normally;  because it was late decided to try this Vet ER.  Best decision, the veterinary team were professional & kind, they treated & resolved his problem. We are very fortunate to have access to this great group of people!

Couldn't be happier or more relieved!  As with most ER visits this was a last minute necessity in the middle of the night.  The vets on staff (David gets 5-stars!) were kind and accommodating and knew exactly what my fur-baby needed.  They examined my dog quickly, gave him his medicine and we were on our way!  The place is very clean and open--nothing is hidden from the pet owner.  While I hope I don't have to go back, I have a lot less stress knowing there's a great place like this in the neighborhood!

It's a place where they truly care about animal welfare. They are very professional, empathetic, and passionate about their work. I highly recommend this wonderful place, especially DVM Parker Brannon.

It's a place where they care about the well-being of the animals. They are very professional, empathetic, and passionate about their work. I highly recommend this wonderful place, especially DVM Parker Brannon.

I recommend them 100%.
Dr. Williams / Marsh
Nurses Beatriz / Nayeli
I'm leaving very happy, even though I arrived very scared.

Dear VEG Team,

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for the compassion and care you showed to my beloved dog, Precious, and to my family. Precious provided me with love and comfort for 13 years, and your team's support was invaluable during this heartbreaking time for both me and my grandmother.

When I brought Precious in at 2:00 AM last week as an emergency, the overnight staff assisted us without hesitation or judgment, despite the tough financial situation my grandmother and I are facing.

When Precious's health declined significantly this past Tuesday, I called to explain that I could not afford to put her down. The morning team immediately invited us in. Neither the staff nor the veterinarians added to our pain or financial burden, allowing Precious to end her suffering peacefully.

A special thank you to Dr. Pedranghelu, Dr. Borriello, and all the technicians and nurses for the incredible care and love you provide every day. Seeing how your staff handled other emergencies confirmed that your team truly consists of rockstars who treat every pet as their own.

I don't know when or if I will ever be able to repay your generosity, but my grandmother and I are deeply grateful for everything you did to help Precious rest peacefully in her final moments.

With deep gratitude,

Miguel

Service
Came in the middle of the night at 2 am and I thought my cat was dying. My mom gave them a call to let them know I was on the way, and they told her to call them when I was at the curb and they’ll run out and grab my cat.

They were so patient, understanding, and kind. My baby had diarrhea on the blanket I brought, and they helped me clean him up and clean the blanket up. They helped me give him all his medications that I was supposed to start at-home and answered all questions I had, regardless of how trivial.

My cat was in a lot of pain and they were incredible with him. I had to move my car and someone stayed with him the whole time I was gone, sitting next to him, petting him, and talking to him, without me even asking for someone to stay with him.

It felt like a very family, community-oriented doctor’s office. It didn’t feel corporate or about profit at all. I think this is the most important part of choosing a veterinarian, because if it’s corporate/you’re just another line item on their accounting statements, that means they’re not going to treat your baby with the empathy and concentration that a correct diagnosis and treatment requires.

Price
They originally quoted me $1900, and when I said that was high and if there’s anyway to lower the price, they worked with me to remove tests. They weren’t judgmental, impatient, or pushy at all.

It ended up being $1350 with all diagnostic tests and medications and taxes. They were able to diagnose him with worms with just the tests they ran and no X-rays (the $1900 would be with X-rays). Honestly this price isn’t bad at all, considering banfield would charge $350 for the same diagnostic tests, not including visit fees or medications (if I had to guess those would run another $200 at banfield). I consider an $800 difference for a 24 hr ER visit not bad at all, I’ve heard that $4k and $5k bills at other places are common.

Even though no one wants to go to the emergency vet, VEG makes it as easy as it can be. The team was very attentive and treated me and my kitty with care. Shoutout to Dr. Brannon for being caring and compassionate! I would recommend VEG to anyone.

Yesterday, we had to say goodbye to our beloved pet, and it was one of the most difficult moments for us. I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team for the incredible care, dedication, and love you showed throughout the process.
You made such a heartbreaking experience a little easier to bear through your compassion, kindness, and professionalism. We are truly grateful for the way you treated our pet and supported us during such a painful time.
Thank you for everything you did. Your kindness will never be forgotten. ❤
Highly highly recommended! Quick, smart, efficient and transparent staff! They want to help and know what they’re doing. Thank you VEG!

I’m so grateful to the entire team at this emergency animal hospital for taking such good care of my cat. They were caring, compassionate, and professional from the moment we arrived. They thoroughly checked my cat, explained everything clearly, and made sure we felt supported throughout the visit. It’s such a relief to know there are people who genuinely care about animals when you need help most. Thank you so much for taking care of my cat!

The Doctors and nurses were amazing!! They treated me and my Pup/Son with open arms and gave immediate help soon as we walked through the door!! I definitely recommend this location !! 10 across the BOARD !! The entire staff was amazing and my baby is feeling better already!!!

I brought a dog we found on the side of the road that had been hit and run to this VEG ER and they were so extremely sweet and helpful in taking it in. They were great with answering the phone and communicating what to do. I really appreciate how kind and gentle they were in a super sad situation.
Very clean place and staff was very attentive. Highly recommend for pet ER
This place is fantastic. So much better than the other 24 hour ERs around here. Truly the best.
Dr.Brannon and nurse Maddy extremely helpful and caring and very reasonable rates. THE BEST!!!!

We had a wonderful experience at Veg ER, when our German Shepard had a seizure in the middle of the night, we rushed over and we were so pleased with the immediate response the moment we walked in, the care attention and information was amazing. The hospital is well equipped and staffed. We were able to stay with our boy for the extent of the visit and when he was admitted, we were welcomed back anytime to go right in and sit with him. The staff was professional, kind and loving with Yosef. Each doctor and nurse we encountered impressed us. 100% recommend this hospital.
Dr. Reyes & Eliana were awesome. They helped me very quickly and reassured me that everything was ok! Great team

We wanted to share our experience at this VEG location last week. We are not new to VEG. We went to the Austin location several times and always had wonderful experiences. This was our first experience at the Miami location, and within two days, we experienced both some of the best and worst veterinary care we've ever received. Our dog, Precious, had heart disease and a collapsed trachea and was under the care of a cardiologist. As her breathing worsened, her cardiologist prescribed hydrocodone. We called VEG trying to find it because it was extremely difficult to locate in Miami, but VEG told us they did not carry it. We eventually found it elsewhere. The next morning, Precious was still struggling, so her cardiologist prescribed theophylline. Because her belly breathing was quite efforted, we went to VEG that morning to try to get the medication. We saw a lovely doctor but again, VEG told us they did not carry this one either. Later that day, we finally found the theophylline. Within roughly an hour of taking it, Precious went into severe respiratory distress with panicking, crying, diarrhea, and an extremely high respiratory rate. She looked like she was actively dying, so we rushed her back to VEG for oxygen. Unfortunately, the doctor overseeing her care that evening made an already traumatic experience significantly worse. I did not get her name, but she was a heavier set Black woman. We spent approximately 15 hours there. Precious was too distressed in the oxygen chamber, so my husband and I held oxygen tubing near her nose for hours, hoping she could stabilize. We also wanted to give the two new medications time to clear her system in case either contributed to this sudden episode. The doctor repeatedly dismissed that possibility, telling us there was "absolutely no way" the medications could have caused a reaction because they "give those two medications all the time." This was especially frustrating because we had literally tried to obtain BOTH medications from VEG and had been told they did not carry either one. Her ego was so big that she needed to prove us wrong by lying. Beyond that, we felt very little compassion. she was very condesending. she never even put her hands on Precious or physically examining her in our presence. What I do remember is repeatedly being asked whether we had paid our bill and whether we'd decided what we wanted to do. We understood Precious was critically ill and knew that if she couldn't stabilize, we might have to say goodbye. We simply wanted to give her a chance to stabilize on oxygen and see whether the episode improved as the medications cleared her system. We became so uncomfortable that we called another VEG location because we didn't feel heard or comfortable having this doctor involved if we had to make an end of life decision. Shortly afterward, our doctor specifically mentioned that she knew we'd called the other location. The interaction felt unnecessarily confrontational during an already devastating situation. Then we met Dr. Alvarez and Nurse Ashley, who were absolute angels. Dr. Alvarez stayed with us even after his shift ended. He examined Precious, listened to us, answered our questions, explained everything thoroughly, and showed genuine compassion for Precious and us. Nurse Ashley was equally kind and wonderful. After approximately 15 hours, we made the heartbreaking decision to let Precious go. There is nobody I would rather have had with us than Dr. Alvarez. He was patient, gentle and caring. He never rushed us and made an unbearable moment a little more bearable. I will remember his kindness for the rest of my life. We somehow experienced the worst and very best of veterinary care in the same visit. I sincerely hope VEG management takes our concerns about the first doctor seriously while also recognizing Dr. Alvarez and Nurse Ashley for their extraordinary care. Precious was our entire world. They gave her and us the compassion and dignity she deserved in her final hours, and for that, we will always be grateful.
Take your pet here. The care, attention and expertise is what is needed to make sure your pet recovers. I would highly recommend VEG.

I took my 10 year old Quaker Parrot to VEG ER location in Edgewater that suffered a leg fracture. The "plan" was $1,600 to x-ray, medicate and provide a splint plus protection for the wound. The bird was sent home with in appropriate precautions not to pick at the wounds, thus resulting in further damage and stress related to the future cause of DEATH. There was several hundred dollars of medication purchased with the plan which they still possess that has not been refunded. If you are bird owner you should look somewhere else. RIP BEAKER!

Dr. Reyes was great with my dog (Tiramisu) last night.  The team was wonderful. The location was very Clean.  Whole experience was less than 45 minutes. No wait time. Would highly recommend as a dog ER. Very comforting.
Hey im that kid with the 6 weeks old kitty,mitchi,i wanna say thank u guys for everything but he on september,12 at 6:43 pm he passed away thanks for your support guys.
Excellent service from Dr. Brannon and Natali, who assisted us from the moment I called. Thank you 🫶🏻 …

Words could not describe how well the entire team of VEG tried to save my cat they treated with such care     The team showed genuine concern for my pet’s well-being. The environment felt welcoming and supportive, especially during an emergency.

I visited VEG Emergency Veterinary Hospital in Edgewater, Miami, yesterday around 1:00 a.m. with my cat, Lily. The check-in process was quick, and there appeared to be plenty of staff available. Everyone was kind and attentive, and I appreciate that aspect of my experience.

However, I was disappointed with several parts of the visit, especially considering the high cost of emergency care. Throughout multiple tests, I was expected to hold my cat myself while a vet technician attempted various procedures. One of the reasons emergency veterinary care is significantly more expensive is the expectation of adequate staffing and assistance, so I did not expect to be responsible for restraining my pet during much of the examination.

While the technician was very sweet and clearly trying her best, there were multiple unsuccessful attempts to perform routine procedures. It took several tries to take Lily's temperature, resulting in the tech mentioning bleeding in that area, which was concerning. There were also issues with the blood pressure cuff placement and repeated attempts to complete eye testing while I struggled to hold my anxious cat wrapped in a towel. During another eye test, several strips were used unsuccessfully, requiring the technician to leave and retrieve additional supplies. These repeated attempts increased both my stress and Lily's anxiety.

Eventually, the technician was unable to complete the eye pressure test. Later, the veterinarian and another staff member entered the room, gave Lily a sedative, and completed the same tests
almost immediately. This left me questioning whether additional assistance or a more experienced staff member should have been involved sooner.

What concerns me most is that some of Lily's symptoms, including bleeding and her lack of appetite, were not addressed, treated, or clearly addressed during the visit. Today, I took Lily to a veterinary ophthalmologist, who questioned why certain findings and concerns had not been treated or discussed by the emergency veterinarian.

Additionally the billing process was a little weird. The technician almost forgot to remind the doctor that I was owed a refund of approximately $300 for services that were not ultimately performed. The doctor seemed to not know that ot was added when i mentioned it. Considering the total cost of the visit was nearly double what I later paid the specialist, it was disappointing to leave without answers or treatment for the issues the emergency veterinarian could have address outside of the Lily's eye issue. They just recommended i go see the specialist asap, whom in return was only able to test her eyes, but not assist with appetite or the blood in her anus.

I will now need to make an addtional appointment with a 3rd vet for the items that were not initially adressed.

Overall, the staff was caring and well-intentioned, but I believe additional training, better support during patient handling, clearer communication, and more thorough follow-up on a pet's presenting symptoms would greatly improve the experience for both patients and pet owners.

Do not trust your pet to these so called vets. They’re not experienced if your pet suffers a real emergency. I had a horrible experience that cost our baby girl her life. Please do your homework before you trust them. You will be sorry

VEG is the place to go for your pet if there is a problem after hours, they are always open and never close. The staff, techs and Dr's are all exceptional and you can always know your pet is in good hands
Excellent customer service, all the Vets,nurses and team God bless them. They took great care of my 🐈 cat. …

My apartment building on 103 street nw  Miami Fl was on fire about 3 days ago it’s on the news .  My neighbor died in the fire.  I had to pay a hotel and because of Labor Day weekend it’s pretty expensive.  I notice signs that my dog may have hook worms. Including bloody diarrhea.. I rushed him to the location that I’ve been before. They wanted me to pay $190 consultation. But I only needed the fecal exam done.. I agree to pay the $190 but I didn’t have $50 for the fecal test so they weren’t able to help me💔I asked to leave my card information so they can take the $50 tomorrow when I get paid but Dr Ragbeer still turned us down.  So I’m back at the hotel waiting for 9am so I can rush my dog to a clinic. I showed pictures of the burnt apartment and I’ve come here couple times before and always pay.  I wish Dr. Ragbeer was a little compassionate
Exceptional! I've been twice and the service is always excellent. 100% recommended.
A vet saw our puppy immediately and made the right diagnostic. He was able to save him

The staff here is wonderful everyone very professional and empathetic.  Special kudos to  Niyae and Jorge Dr Raa and Dr Bush they helped me feel at ease with the treatment of my beloved shadow he is not out of the woods yet but I have the faith he will be ok thanks to the team at veg. The entire staff is amazing.

I cannot say enough good things about the team here. I brought my  cat, Luna, to the ER after she stopped eating and was having trouble. They quickly figured out that she had a fever and an issue with her kidneys. Throughout the entire visit, Luna was such a good patient, and the team went above and beyond to make both of us feel comfortable and supported.

Special thanks to Brandy at the front desk and the sweet front desk girl who checked us in (I forgot her name, but she was wonderful!). Also, huge appreciation to Dr. Jorge (or "Georgie," as they affectionately call him)he was so amazing, kind, and informative. He explained everything that was happening with Luna, kept me updated every step of the way, and was so professional.

I loved that they are so transparent and you can actually see how well they treat and care for your pet. They truly love animals and treat them like their own. I definitely and wholeheartedly recommend bringing your pets here if they ever need emergency care! Thank you all for taking such good care of my Luna! ❤️

Hi Dwayne!
Thank you for your 5-star rating!

Terra and Maddy are top of the line!

Had amazing experience with their kindness, empathy, thoroughness and overall care.

Five Stars 👏👏👏👏
Dr. Parker Brannon and the entire team were absolutely amazing, compassionate, professional and took care of my cat Jade in the most graceful manner. I am truly grateful for them.

The entire VEG team was absolutely amazing with my Luna. She was incredibly sick and needed to be hospitalized, which was such a scary experience, but everyone treated her with so much kindness and compassion. Even if she was under the care of a specific doctor or vet tech, I could ask anyone a question and they were always willing to help. I could also call at any time during the night to check on her, and I was even offered the option to stay overnight with her. I’m so grateful for how attentive, patient, and caring everyone was with my girl. ❤️
This place was extremely helpful and kind in a really tough moment with a dog dealing with end stage cancer.  Can’t say enough good things about them.

Very expensive never again didn’t even get a real diagnose for my dog  and they couldn’t even do the letter for me of certification because they didn’t feel comfortable but felt real comfortable charging me all that money horrible

I rarely ever write reviews, but when I do, it’s because I had the overwhelming pleasure of being attended by the most professional, caring, kind, and knowledgeable individuals ever. Mason, my pup and my whole world, was attended here and this VEG ER in Miami (Midtown) is the epitome of efficiency. Clean, super organized, and literally built for total efficiency/lab analysis. It’s literally one giant laboratory. No waiting whatsoever, someone immediately show me to a seat where they asked me what was going on. Dr. Borriello, David, and others were the best ever. Prices were of course what’s expected for an ER but actually cheaper than other ERs. I was at the ER all day and they regularly checked in with me, took their time talking to me, gave Mason so much love, and still efficiently moved on to the next patient. I never once saw anyone distracted on their phone or idle doing nothing. Every single person working there I can tell deeply cares about their role and the impact they’re making. I’m so grateful to everyone there. This should be everyone’s choice for ER services in Miami!!
We came in needing help. Dr. Nicole and the team were kind, professional, and attentive. They kept Brandon comfortable, and explained things clearly. We felt cared for and would recommend them.

Having to take your pet to the ER is super scary and stressful but everyone at VEG was super friendly and helpful. I love that I get to stay with my dog through the whole experience. I am very happy with them and would definitely bring my dog back. But hopefully I won’t have to. :)
Dr. Brannon and nurse Mimi were great! They explained everything as we went and answered all our questions. They took excellent care of our dog.

Honestly, this is the best clinic I’ve been to in Miami; they saved my dog’s life, treated her like a princess, and were very clear about the procedures and costs. I am so grateful because, in such difficult situations, it is important to have professionals who know how to handle the situation and provide support to both me and my baby.

VEG ER Miami gave Elly, my mini dachshund, the best emergency care and quality of service we have ever received. She arrived with an injury, digestive symptoms, and breathing trouble, and the team began treating her immediately. Through testing, medication, surgery, and hospitalization, they showed exceptional medical skill, compassion, and communication. Instead of overwhelming me, they sent me home with a clear one-page summary containing everything I needed to know. Their bedside manner was better than most human doctors—I would trust them with my own medical care if they would take me! Elly is recovering well, and I truly believe they saved her life and gave us more precious time together. Thank you, Gaspairn, Klipin, Bush, Comiesha, Nijoe, Nicole, Manu, Yuni, Brandi, and Denise. 💯🐾

A much deserved thank you to VEG and their midtown team especially:  Dr. K, Beatrice, Caitlyn, and Conneshia.

I rushed my foster kitten in after waking up to her not moving, and barely breathing. The emergency team worked quickly and TRULY did ABSOLUTELY everything that they can do to save sweet Sage. Most importantly, they allowed me to stay by her side during every moment and procedure. They even allowed me to hold her as they were attempting to get her levels back to normal. After hours of doing EVERYTHING they could, we made the difficult decision to let her go.

Between them being resourceful, compassionate, and on top of everything... I knew that Sage was in the best hands.

Although I hope to never have to be back, VEG will have my business.

This is the most amazing set of doctors and nurses I have ever seen in the vet world. The experience at VEG is one of a kind and the opportunity to stay with your pet during every step of care is such an incredible gift.

Amazing caring team.  So grateful they were able to take care of my little chihuahua when he was sick in the middle of the night. I was very concerned especially because he is 17 but they got him through a delicate situation and he’s home now.

Everything in this place was outstanding!! Dr. Brennan and the team gave my dog such care at a time when I was so upset about him being attacked /  fight with a bigger dog. They were professional, the place was spotless and everyone was so caring! I give them high marks and recommend going here if ever you are in an emergency with your pet 100%. Kudos to George who cared for Kimbo. I do not remember everyone’s name but they were ALL great.

This hospital is very fast and caring. All the veterinarians are incredibly kind and lovely, and they treat our babies as if they were their own. I highly recommend it! 🫶🏼🥰 Thank you, Laura and Cocoliso …
Our visit exceeded our expectations! Stella and Dr Chloe were exceptionally helpful and professional while being very supportive. We loved Stella!!! Thank you!!!!

I took my dog here due to an emergency at 4 am and no local vets being open at that time in the Keys. Im glad to say it was the best decision. The staff was amazing, kind, and informative. They helped our dog out and made sure we understood his treatment plan before leaving.
Thank you Esthela, Chloe and team for the kindness and humanity in treating Bruno to make him feel better. Thank you very much!!! 100% recommended.
A very good service and quick attention with my dog Aicha, thanks to Dr Williams and Yuni.
Unremarkable team from the instant we walked in the door.

Hello Victoria,
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We’re thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience with our team. Your feedback inspires us to continue working together to deliver great service.
Awesome service, thanks Dr. Reyes,Stella and Brandi
Very sympathetic and helpful during my dogs euthanasia.
Came in as a walk in to check my boys anal glands and they were so quick and sweet! He didnt even squirm or scream. So grateful they were able to put my mind at ease.

I was very satisfied with my visit. Dr. Lilia Bush and Jackie took great care of Milan and answered all of my questions. They were both extremely kind, caring, and helpful throughout my visit. I truly appreciate the time and attention they gave us, and I’m very grateful for their wonderful care.
Excellent service with an  amazing staff.

I brought my dog in Saturday afternoon because his paw was really swollen and he was limping. To be fair, the staff was super nice and everyone took good care of him. I don’t have any complaints about the care or how we were treated.

That said, $2,000 for this visit is honestly insane. I get that vet care can be expensive, especially at an urgent/emergency clinic, but I just don’t understand how it got anywhere near $2,000 for a swollen paw and limping.

The price felt way out of proportion to what we came in for. I left feeling like I was charged an outrageous amount for something that, while definitely worrying as a pet owner, didn’t feel like it should cost that much.

If you go here, definitely ask for extremely necessary services, because costs can add up fast. The staff may be kind and professional, but in my experience the pricing is just not reasonable.

I really wanted to have a good experience here, but a $2,000 bill for this visit is really hard to justify
If your animal is sick in Miami, this is where you want to go. Period.

Outstanding care and service! The entire staff at VEG was compassionate, efficient, and direct with their treatment plan. They kept me updated the entire time and handled my dog with so much love and respect. If you ever find yourself in a pet emergency, this is the place you want to be.
A special thank you to Dr. Ragbeer and our nurse Eliana. You both showed extraordinary skill and genuine kindness, and it made all the difference in the world.

love Omar. he cared for my cat who I brought in at 3 am, I was terrified and Omar was caring and attentive, showed me everything he was doing and provided an explanation so I understood, I left reassured and with a weight off my shoulders

I want to take a moment to recognize the incredible service I received during my recent visit to the VEG ER.

From the moment I arrived, the process was immediate and seamless. My puppy was taken straight to a table, seen by a doctor quickly, and, most importantly, I was able to stay by my puppy’s side throughout the entire process. I never once had to leave him, which meant so much to me during such a stressful and scary situation.

I especially want to thank Omar — he is truly the best! From the moment I walked in with my puppy, Omar was able to recognize what was going on based on his presenting symptoms. He is extremely knowledgeable, confident, and clearly knows his stuff. I felt like my puppy was in very capable hands.

His customer service was 10/10. He was kind, attentive, and made an incredibly stressful experience feel much easier.

Ashley and Jessica were also so sweet and compassionate. They both made me feel comfortable and supported throughout the visit.

If you ever unfortunately find yourself needing to go to the VEG ER, I highly recommend asking for Omar, Jessica, and Ashley. They truly are the best!

Thank you all so much for taking such great care of my puppy and for making a scary experience a little easier. I genuinely appreciate you guys! ❤️

If your pet is having an emergency, don’t hesitate to bring them here.

I had a very stressful situation with my cat involving multiple digestive complications. From the moment I called, the staff treated the situation with urgency, kindness, and genuine compassion. I believe I spoke with Dr. Omar over the phone, and he had us come in right away. We arrived about 20 minutes later.

My cat—and I—had the best experience we could have hoped for during such a scary time. Dr. Omar and the entire team took the time to explain everything clearly, showed me exactly what was going on, answered all of my questions, and gave me great recommendations on how to care for her moving forward. I truly felt that they cared about my cat’s well-being and wanted the best outcome for her.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Omar and all of the wonderful ladies who took such great care of my cat. I am incredibly grateful for your professionalism, compassion, and the excellent care you provided.

Absolutely professional. They treat your pet as a priority from the very first minute. Your pet is attended to at all times by two or three people, undergoing all kinds of tests, analyses, and examinations. And all of this is done right in front of you, face to face. You can see firsthand how they care for your pet, and they don't hide anything. The work and care are exceptional, from the doctors like Dr. Terra and Gasparin to the nurses Jorgito, Sandra, Gaby, and Natalie, plus a few others. This is coming from someone who lost my dog ​​Chelo there, but they've already saved the life of our little Chihuahua, Linda, twice. Forever grateful!
They were wonderful.  So loving and caring. Had us out of there in no time!!!

Brought my baby here a few times when he has his Shar Pei fever flare ups.  They are so accommodating to him and I love the open concept where the owner can be present throughout the entire process .  Definitely reccomend them

I cannot thank the team at Veterinary Emergency Group (VEG) on Biscayne enough for the care they gave my Golden Retriever, Moose, and me during one of the hardest weeks of my life.

I came in looking for a second opinion after another clinic had completely missed what turned out to be lymphoma. Because of the thoroughness and attention to detail of the doctors and staff at VEG, they immediately recognized that something much more serious was going on. They performed the appropriate testing, connected the dots, and ultimately set us on the path to getting Moose the care he urgently needed. I’ll always be grateful for that.

I especially want to recognize Dr. Mariah Williams. While I wish the news had been different, she was the doctor who recognized that Moose’s enlarged lymph nodes were highly concerning for lymphoma and immediately took action. She was incredibly thorough, compassionate, and honest while guiding me through one of the hardest conversations I’ve ever had. Looking back, I’m so grateful she trusted her instincts and didn’t dismiss what she was seeing. Because of her diligence, Moose was able to begin the process of getting the oncology care he needed as quickly as possible.

While hearing that your dog likely has cancer is devastating, every single person I encountered from the front desk staff to the technicians to the veterinarians…treated both of us with incredible kindness, compassion, and respect. I never felt rushed, and every question I had was answered with patience and genuine empathy.

What truly set VEG apart was the support they provided even after we left. While we were waiting to get in with an oncologist, Moose’s breathing had me terrified. I called their overnight on-call veterinarian several times because I was so worried, and every single time I was met with reassurance, thoughtful guidance, and kindness. What I’ll never forget is being told that if I needed to call again at 2am, 4am, or even every hour throughout the night, I should…that they were there for us. Knowing there was someone willing to answer the phone in the middle of the night and patiently walk me through my concerns gave me comfort during one of the scariest moments of my life. That level of compassion is incredibly rare.

When you’re facing an emergency with a pet you love, you need a team that combines medical excellence with genuine humanity. VEG did exactly that. They made one of the worst moments of my life feel a little less overwhelming because I knew Moose was in capable, caring hands.

I sincerely hope no one ever needs an emergency veterinarian, but if you do, this is exactly where you want to be. I will never hesitate to bring Moose back here in the future. Thank you to Dr. Mariah Williams and the entire VEG Biscayne team for your expertise, your compassion, and for helping Moose when he needed you most. I will never forget everything you did for us. ❤️

I am forever grateful to the entire team at VEG for the compassion, kindness, and exceptional care they showed our beloved kitty, Bella.

We first came to VEG because Bella wasn't doing well, and our veterinarian suspected there might be something wrong with her spleen. Dr. Gabriela Reyes was the attending veterinarian that day. Later that same night, Bella suddenly began gasping for air and could no longer move. We rushed her back to VEG immediately. By then, the ultrasound report had come back and confirmed our worst fear: Bella had a very aggressive cancerous tumor in her spleen, and surgery was no longer an option.

As heartbreaking as it was, our family made the difficult decision to let Bella go peacefully so she would no longer suffer.

Dr. Gabriela Reyes showed us extraordinary compassion during one of the hardest moments of our lives. She gave us the time we needed, answered our questions with honesty and empathy, and helped make an impossible decision just a little more bearable. I will never forget her kindness.

Always happy to leave a review when you meet dedicated professionals. Our baby bearded dragon needed emergency surgery for a prolapse, and the entire team was caring, knowledgeable, and efficient. The surgery went smoothly, the follow-up visit for suture removal was excellent, and we felt our little dragon was in great hands.

Lola was our beloved 8-year-old cat, and unfortunately, we had to say goodbye to her after she became critically ill. Two days before our visit to VEG ER for Pets, Lola became very sick. She was vomiting and clearly not feeling well, so we took her to our regular veterinary clinic. Lola was examined and given medication, and we hoped she would improve. Sadly, over the next two days her condition declined significantly.
On Sunday night, when her health became much worse, we were referred to VEG ER for Pets. We were attended to immediately and were in excellent hands with Dr. Rebecca Klimpin and Nurse Ashleigh. What an amazing and compassionate team. Sadly, Lola was in very critical condition. She had fluid in her abdomen, and after careful evaluation, we learned that she would not have survived surgery. We made the heartbreaking decision to let her go peacefully.
Before any treatment was started, we were given an estimate of what would be required to diagnose and treat her. The cost was shockingly high - outrageous—over $2,288 just for the examination and diagnostics. This did not include treatment, hospitalization, or any additional care. My husband and I were truly stunned by the amount.
What disappointed us was not only the price, but also the way it was presented. The gentleman who discussed the estimate with us - came across as arrogant and showed lack of compassion and understanding for the emotional situation we were facing. At a moment when we were worried about our beloved pet and trying to process difficult news, a little more empathy would have meant a great deal.
That being said, I want to emphasize how grateful we are for Dr. Rebecca Klimpin, Nurse Ashleigh, and the entire VEG team. Every staff member we encountered was kind, supportive, professional, and genuinely caring. Despite the many emergency cases they were handling that evening, everyone took the time to treat us with respect and compassion. We could see how hard the team works, and we are truly thankful for the care they provided during one of the most difficult moments.
Losing a pet is like losing a member of the family, and their kindness made a heartbreaking situation a little easier to bear.
My only concern is the extremely high cost of emergency veterinary care. We rescue animals, and while we understand that emergency medicine is expensive, the prices can be overwhelming for many. It saddens me to think that some pet owners or rescuers may struggle to afford the care their animals need during a crisis.
Thank you to Dr. Rebecca Klimpin, Nurse Ashleigh, and the entire team for helping Lola and for supporting us during her final moments.

My experience at VEG was excellent. It was my first time, and I have no words to express my gratitude to the entire team, especially Dr. Ricardo Álvarez, Nurse Conneshia and her assistant Mimi, CEC Ashley, and the whole team. I recommend them 100%.
